lead.content: The analysis uses calendar-month concentration, and keeps two quantities strictly separate throughout.

eventBody.content: The number of outbreak-report records falling in a calendar month.

caseSub.content: How many cases those reports contain

caseBody.content: Total cases reported within those records. One large report can contribute many cases without creating many separate events.

rule2026.content: 2026 comparison rule: only W01–W32 is compared against the matched historical window. No full-year extrapolation or forecast is produced.
